uses: Relief of mild-to-moderate pain (headache, muscle ache, toothache, period pain) and reducing fever.
side_effects: Rare at normal doses; occasional nausea or rash.
warnings: Do not exceed 4000 mg in 24 hours. Overdose can cause severe, sometimes silent liver damage. Avoid regular heavy alcohol use.

uses: Pain relief, reducing inflammation and fever (arthritis, muscle strain, dental pain, period pain).
warnings: Take with food. Raises the risk of stomach bleeding and can affect the kidneys and blood pressure, especially with regular use.
max_daily_dose: 1200 mg per 24 hours without medical advice (OTC label)

uses: Relieves pain and fever; low-dose aspirin is used, on medical advice, to reduce heart attack and stroke risk.
side_effects: Indigestion, easy bruising, ringing in the ears at high doses.
warnings: Increases bleeding risk. Not for children with a viral illness (Reye's syndrome risk). Do not combine with other NSAIDs.
max_daily_dose: 4000 mg per 24 hours for pain relief (OTC label); low-dose regimens are prescribed separately

uses: Pain relief and inflammation reduction for arthritis, muscle aches and menstrual cramps.
warnings: Carries the same stomach, kidney and cardiovascular NSAID warnings as ibuprofen. Do not combine with other NSAIDs.

uses: Treats high blood pressure and heart failure; often called a 'blood pressure medication'.
side_effects: Persistent dry cough, dizziness, headache, raised blood potassium.
warnings: Not for use in pregnancy. Do not stop suddenly without medical advice. Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Treats high blood pressure and helps protect the kidneys in some people with diabetes; a 'blood pressure medication'.
warnings: Not for use in pregnancy. Do not combine with an ACE inhibitor unless a specialist has prescribed it.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: A 'water pill' used for high blood pressure and fluid retention.
side_effects: Increased urination, dizziness, low potassium or sodium.
warnings: Dehydration can strain the kidneys; blood tests may be needed to check salts and kidney function.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Lowers LDL cholesterol and reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke.
warnings: Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice. Report unexplained muscle pain or weakness promptly.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: A 'blood thinner' used to prevent and treat harmful blood clots.
warnings: Needs regular INR blood tests. Many medicines and diet changes affect it; ask before starting or stopping anything.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Treats certain bacterial infections such as ear, throat, chest and urinary infections.
warnings: Do not use if allergic to penicillin. Only works on bacteria, not colds or flu. Complete the full prescribed course.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Relieves allergy symptoms such as hay fever, runny nose and itchy eyes.
warnings: May cause drowsiness; take care driving. Limit alcohol while taking it.

uses: Reduces stomach acid for heartburn, acid reflux and stomach ulcers.
side_effects: Headache, stomach pain, diarrhoea or constipation.
warnings: Long-term use can lower vitamin B12 and magnesium; use only as long as advised.
max_daily_dose: 20 mg per 24 hours for 14 days (OTC label)

uses: Controls blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
warnings: Kidney problems, dehydration or heavy alcohol use may require pausing it; ask your doctor before contrast dye scans.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Treats high blood pressure and angina; a 'blood pressure medication'.
warnings: May cause low blood pressure when starting. Do not stop suddenly without medical advice.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Treats high blood pressure, angina and certain heart rhythm problems; a 'blood pressure medication'.
side_effects: Tiredness, cold hands and feet, slow heart rate.
warnings: Do not stop suddenly. May not be suitable with asthma. Can mask low blood sugar warning signs in diabetes.
max_daily_dose: Prescription only - follow your prescriber's instructions

uses: Relieves allergy symptoms and occasional sleeplessness.
warnings: Causes marked drowsiness; avoid driving or alcohol. Use caution in older adults.
